name: Farr's Dalston
summary: A bar and pub in Dalston that is also hired out for private events. The listings site ma.to adds that it serves artisan pizza and holds weekly events.

music.notes: Vinyl DJ sessions and a pub quiz, according to the listings site ma.to.

cost.notes: Private hire of the basement venue starts at £200 for an evening, for up to 100 guests.

evidence.quote: Farr’s Dalston is a buzzy bar, pub, and private hire event venue that’s become a local favourite.
Farr’s Dalston is a rustic community bar in London serving artisan pizza and hosting eclectic weekly cultural events
featuring a regular pub quiz, vinyl DJ sessions
Weekly vinyl sessions and 2-4-1 cocktails in Dalston with OG Osbrain.
Host your event for up to 100 guest in our private basement venue from £200 for the whole evening.
17–19 Dalston Lane, E8 3DF, just a few steps from Dalston Junction
